method: Each statement keeps Bloomberg’s anonymous-source attribution, distinguishes an interest statement from an agreement, and isolates the earlier Pachocki post from the reported meeting.

supports.passage: It reports that, at a company-wide meeting that week, Altman said OpenAI could potentially pace development with several other labs; people familiar with the private details requested anonymity. It says some labs may not agree.
people familiar with the private details requested anonymity

This is attributed reporting of an internal discussion. It does not establish an announced pause, a pact, a timeline, or a product-policy change. The accessible reprint locks the remainder of the article.

Reuters reports Bloomberg said Altman told staff OpenAI was open to slowing development amid safety concerns and might pace development with other labs. Reuters says an Anthropic spokesperson expressed interest in working with the industry on the pace of releasing new tools.

Pachocki writes that OpenAI will seek to align, monitor, and build defenses against more powerful systems and will unilaterally withhold further scaling as needed; he says broader interventions will also be needed.
